definitions.short: Etsbon , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H675. Etsbon אֶצְבּוֺן proper name, masculine 1. אֶצְבֹּן a son of Gad (Samaritan ᵐ5 אצבעון, Θασοβαν ) Gen 46:16 = אָזְנִי Num 26:16 ( ᵐ5 Ἀζενει , Ἀζαν ), this shorter form less probable. 2 אֶצְבּוֺן a grandson of Benjamin 1Chr 7:7 ( ᵐ5 Ἀσεβων , Ἐσσεβων ). אֶצְבַּע see II. צבע . [ אצל ] probably i. q. to join (compare on the א W SG 71 ).
